reason: The current GRURec achieves macro validation HR@10=0.5737, with Electronics at 0.435, but its independent positive/negative softplus terms do not directly optimize competition among candidates. Historical sampled-softmax experiments support testing a relative-ranking objective, without establishing that it will improve this GRU. Modify loss design and its training-loop implementation only, preserving the successful recurrent architecture and existing sampling to isolate the objective change.

plan.model_design: Replace the independent binary logistic objective with sampled-softmax cross-entropy over each valid position's positive and eight existing uniform negatives, placing the positive at class zero. Following the historical sampled-softmax experiment, make candidates compete directly while retaining the current eight-negative configuration to isolate the loss hypothesis. Preserve GRURec, its constructor, encode, score, and predict signatures, and its 96-dimensional embeddings, two GRU layers, tied normalized embeddings, jointly learned item bias and score scale, dropout, and maximum history length; introduce no additional predictors or scoring components.

Keep NEGATIVES=8, uniform sampling, target-collision resampling, duplicate-negative behavior, history windowing, optimizer, learning rate, batch size, mixed precision, clipping, epoch limit, deadlines, and early stopping unchanged. Preserve preprocessing seed=0, training seed=42, the supplied splits, all four categories, DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], and single-GPU execution, with no hidden-test access or external data.
